names: Maria de Lourdes Ruivo da Silva de Matos Pintasilgo
summary: Maria de Lourdes Pintasilgo (1930–2004) was a chemical engineer and a former minister who was prime minister from August 1979 to January 1980, at the head of a government the President named to hold office until the election of December 1979. She is in the atlas as the only woman to have held the office.
